# Supported models

<!-- Generated by `go run ./scripts/genmodels docs/models.md` from the converter's tables; do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated from the converter's own lists, so it is the list and not a description of it:
a GGUF architecture, Hugging Face class or vision projector that is not here is refused at conversion,
by name. `internal/srcgate.TestModelsDocIsGenerated` fails when the page and the code part; rerun
`go run ./scripts/genmodels docs/models.md`.

- **69** GGUF text architecture names (`general.architecture`, `convert.Architectures`) on **60** graphs
- **31** Hugging Face safetensors classes (`architectures` in `config.json`, `convert.HFClasses`) on **24** graphs, **1** of them reached only from safetensors
- **61** graphs in all (`jlm.Arch`)
- **19** vision projectors (`clip.projector_type`, `convert.Projectors`)
- **3** embedding encoders, and pooling on any decoder
- **15** weight types read (`quant.Dequantable`), **11** of them packed quantizations (`quant.PackedTypes`)
- **87** models in the download catalogue (`jitllm library`), **9** of them with a vision tower

## Vision projectors

A vision model is one container: the text model's GGUF and its tower's (`clip`, the mmproj)
convert together, the text model one of the architectures above. The projector is the tower's
`clip.projector_type`.

| Projector | Models |
|---|---|
| `d1omni_v` | d1-omni-600M's vision half (LFM2-VL's tower and projector, bilinear tiles; its rows a prefix of the decision prompt) |

| `gemma3nv` | Gemma 3n E2B, E4B (MobileNet-V5) |
| `gemma4v` | Gemma 4 |

| `lfm2` | LFM2-VL, LFM2.5-VL and d1-3B (SigLIP2 NaFlex, tiles and a thumbnail) |
| `llama4` | Llama 4 Scout, Maverick |

## Embedding models

Encoders, run by the engine's encoder rather than its decoder graph:

- `bert`: all-MiniLM, mxbai-embed-large, bge-large, snowflake-arctic-embed (embeddings)
- `modern-bert`: Laya (decision model, /v1/systemone)
- `nomic-bert`: nomic-embed-text (embeddings)

Any decoder above also converts as an embedding model when its GGUF states `pooling_type` 1 (mean),
2 (first token) or 3 (last token): Qwen3-Embedding is `qwen3`, EmbeddingGemma `gemma3`. `pooling_type`
4, a reranker's head, is refused. Embeddings are served by `jitllm embed` and `/v1/embeddings`.

## Weight types

Read: F32, F16, Q4_0, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, Q3_K, Q4_K, Q5_K, Q6_K, IQ4_NL, BF16, TQ1_0, TQ2_0, MXFP4.

Packed quantizations: Q4_0, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, Q3_K, Q4_K, Q5_K, Q6_K, MXFP4, TQ2_0, TQ2_F32. A GGUF's quantization is kept; `-q8` stores a float safetensors model's
matrices as Q8_0.
